**Is your feature request related to a problem?**
A clear and concise description of the problem, e.g. "I'm always frustrated when...".

**Describe the solution you'd like**
A clear and concise description of what you want to happen.

**Describe alternatives you've considered**
Other approaches you considered and why they don't work as well.

**Additional context**
Anything else relevant (screenshots, mockups, links).

**Impact on multi-tenancy / accounting (if any)**
This project stores per-company financial and inventory data. If your request
touches records or reports, note any implications for tenant isolation or
accounting correctness.
